slides.title: Cloud Native, Testing & Advanced Communication (158 to 163)
slides.prompt: Assessment covering Docker Containerization, Kubernetes Orchestration, Pytest, OpenTelemetry, API Gateways, and GraphQL/gRPC.
slides.codeSnippet:
# Cloud Native, Testing & Advanced Communication Assessment
print('Starting Comprehensive Test')

slides.title: Question 1: Dockerfile Base Image
slides.prompt: Fill in the Dockerfile keyword used to define the parent runtime image.

slides.title: Question 2: Multi-Stage Docker Builds
slides.prompt: Why are multi-stage Docker builds recommended for Python production images?
options: They significantly reduce final image size by discarding build tools and compilers
They allow running multiple web servers inside one container
They eliminate the need for requirements.txt
slides.correctAnswer: They significantly reduce final image size by discarding build tools and compilers

slides.title: Question 3: Basic Compute Unit
slides.prompt: Fill in the smallest deployable computing unit in Kubernetes that wraps one or more containers.

slides.title: Question 4: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA)
slides.prompt: What metric does the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler typically monitor to scale Python API pods dynamically?
options: CPU utilization and memory usage limits
slides.correctAnswer: CPU utilization and memory usage limits

slides.title: Question 5: Reusable Test Setup Fixtures
slides.prompt: Fill in the Pytest decorator used to define reusable test setup and teardown components.

slides.title: Question 6: Mocking External Dependencies
slides.prompt: Which library or fixture is used to replace slow or external network calls during unit testing?

slides.title: Question 7: Tracing Context Spans
slides.prompt: Fill in the OpenTelemetry method used to create a trace context block for operational measurement.

slides.title: Question 8: Prometheus Metrics Types
slides.prompt: Which Prometheus metric type is ideal for measuring memory usage or current active worker threads?

slides.title: Question 9: Reverse Proxy Routing
slides.prompt: Fill in the Nginx directive used to pass incoming HTTP requests to a backend Python server.

slides.title: Question 10: Load Balancing Algorithms
slides.prompt: Which load balancing algorithm distributes requests sequentially across all available healthy backend nodes?

slides.title: Question 11: GraphQL Single Endpoint
slides.prompt: Fill in the standard HTTP method used to execute GraphQL query and mutation requests.

slides.title: Question 12: Protocol Buffers Advantage
slides.prompt: Why is gRPC Protocol Buffer serialization faster than standard REST JSON over HTTP/1.1?
options: It uses binary serialization and multiplexed HTTP/2 streams
It compresses data using plain zip files
It skips data validation steps entirely
It stores all messages directly in Redis cache
slides.correctAnswer: It uses binary serialization and multiplexed HTTP/2 streams
